sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed pages 460-461 state that Szondi divides neuroses by the applied `Abwehrtechnik` into `Zwangsneurosen oder Ichneurosen` and `Überraschungs- oder Paroxysmalneurosen`. For the first he names egosystolic Verneinung and Introjektion leading to reaction formations in the Ich; for the second he describes special Ich-Abwehr combined with paroxysmal affective surprise mechanisms and lists Konversionshysterie, Angsthysterie/Phobie and Affektepilepsie as source-era members.

sourceExcerpt: Dieser Auffassung entsprechend teilen wir auch die Neurosen auf Grund der Art der angewandten Abwehrtechnik in:
romanianRendering: Szondi împarte nevrozele după tipul tehnicii de apărare în două familii: Zwangs-/Ichneurosen și Überraschungs-/Paroxysmalneurosen. Prima pune accent pe mecanisme egosystolisch în Ich; a doua combină Ich-Abwehr cu mecanisme afective paroxysmale de surpriză.
doctrinalStatement: Clasificarea triebpsychologisch de nivel înalt a nevrozelor este organizată după `Abwehrtechnik`: (A) `Zwangsneurosen / Ichneurosen`, în care Szondi descrie egosystolische Verneinung și Introjektion cu Reaktionsbildungen în Ich; (B) `Überraschungs- / Paroxysmalneurosen`, în care Ich-Abwehr este combinată cu mecanisme afective paroxysmale din Überraschungstrieb. Distincția clasifică tehnica de apărare în modelul sursei; nu autorizează diagnosticarea dintr-un singur mecanism.
conditions: Classify only at the source's Abwehrtechnik level and preserve the distinction between egosystolic Ich mechanisms and combined paroxysmal affective mechanisms.
Use the source-era group labels only within Szondi's historical neurosis framework.
exceptions: Do not infer Zwangsneurose from Verneinung or Introjektion alone.
Do not infer a Paroxysmalneurose from an isolated affective/paroxysmal sign alone.
Do not map the historical groups directly onto contemporary diagnostic categories.
scopeNotes: Szondi lists Konversionshysterie, Angsthysterie/Phobie and Affektepilepsie under the Paroxysmalneurosen; the detailed syndromatics of those forms are treated later and are not serialized here.
The specific Zwangsneurose and conversion/phobia sections remain separate future extraction targets if they add nonredundant structure.

relations.note: Organizes the general neurosis framework into two source-defined defense-technique families.

ambiguities: Canonical U005156-U005162 contains OCR damage in several compound words; admitted PDF printed pages 460-461 resolve the classification terms.
